_about: One figurine per job in the building (lab/universe/PLAN.md, 'Version 4: a figurine per job'). Written by Claude; the kit builds every id here. 'do' is what the figure is visibly doing, 'look' what makes the job readable at a glance.

vision.do: looks through a brass telescope on a tripod, sweeps it slowly, then points far off

judgement.do: raises a gavel and brings it down on a sound block, a beat between strikes
judgement.look: gavel and block, a judge's collar

ceo.do: stands easy, sips a mug, glances at a phone in the other hand, nods
ceo.look: human head with hair, mug, phone, a jacket shape; the calm one

taste.do: holds two colour swatches up side by side, tilts the head, lifts one and lowers the other
taste.look: two big swatch cards, a beret

standards.do: holds a clipboard, ticks a big tick on it, then holds it up
standards.look: clipboard with a large tick, a pencil behind the ear

link-reader.do: holds a tablet, swipes up with a finger, eyes follow
link-reader.look: big tablet with a glowing screen

inspiration-scout.do: lifts binoculars, sweeps left to right, lowers them

search-probe.do: types a question on a small terminal; a question mark pops above, then a tick replaces it

divergent-thinker.do: head tilted, scratches the head; a lightbulb above flicks on and glows
divergent-thinker.look: lightbulb above the head, odd socks or a bent antenna: the one who thinks sideways

idea-ranker.do: holds three number cards 1, 2, 3 and swaps two of them round

trend-radar.do: a radar dish on its backpack sweeps round; the figure looks where it points

researcher.do: flips pages of an open book, pushes up reading glasses
researcher.look: open book, round glasses, a short stack of books at its feet

fact-checker.do: holds a magnifier over a page, then makes a tick with a red pen

scriptwriter.do: types on a typewriter; the carriage slides and returns

voice-checker.do: wears big headphones, nods along, holds up a thumb
voice-checker.look: big headphones, a small sound-wave card

clarity-coach.do: points a pointer at a little board with three short bars, then blows a whistle
clarity-coach.look: coach's cap, whistle, pointer, small board

video-editor.do: snaps a clapperboard shut, again and again

voice-music.do: sings into a microphone on a stand; a music note bobs up beside it

motion-designer.do: draws an arc in the air with a stylus; a small ball follows the arc
motion-designer.look: stylus, a ball on an arc

cover-designer.do: paints on a small easel with a brush, steps back to look
cover-designer.look: easel with a bright canvas, brush

carousels.do: fans out a stack of square cards, closes them, fans again

builder.do: hammers a block with a hammer

scheduler.do: flips the pages of a desk calendar and taps a date

poster.do: slaps a big round send button; a paper plane lifts off and loops
poster.look: big button on a post, paper plane

results-reader.do: holds up a bar chart whose bars grow, then nods

replier.do: speech bubbles pop up one after another beside it as it types on a phone

amplifier.do: shouts into a megaphone; rings pulse out of it

account-researcher.do: opens a folder and pulls out a page, studies it

call-prep.do: reads cue cards, mouths the words, flips to the next card

crm-updater.do: drops index cards into a card box one by one

notetaker.do: writes fast in a notebook, headset on

outbound-drafts.do: folds a letter and seals it into an envelope

follow-up.do: paces a few steps, checks a wristwatch, holds up an envelope

coder.do: types on a laptop; the screen glows and lines scroll

reviewer.do: reads a printout, shakes its head, then gives a thumbs up

deployer.do: pulls a lever; a small rocket lifts off its pad and settles back

tester.do: holds a magnifier over a little bug on a block; the bug scurries, it follows

fixer.do: turns a wrench on a bolt, tool belt on

librarian.do: lifts a book up onto a shelf
librarian.look: book, small shelf, glasses on a chain

file-archive.do: slides a filing drawer open, drops a file in, shuts it

content-archive.do: stacks film reels and tapes one on another

inspiration-house.do: pins a picture onto a small mood board

taste-standards.do: balances a pair of scales that tip and level

auditor.do: checks a long checklist down with a pen, visor on

analyst.do: a pie chart floats in front of it and turns; it points at a slice

trend-spotter.do: a line graph card in hand; it traces the line up with a finger

learnings.do: sticks a sticky note onto a notebook, then another

chief-of-staff.do: headset on, clipboard in one hand, points out to the floors with the other, turning to a new floor each beat
chief-of-staff.look: the biggest figure: headset, clipboard, a lanyard; in charge and proactive

courier.do: rides the lift holding a parcel in both hands, bouncing a little
